Path2 Hydrogen AG: CEO to Speak at Hydrogen State of Industry Forum
"Hydrogen After the Hype: What's Real, What's Changed, and What's Next"
Path2 Hydrogen CEO to Speak at Hydrogen State of Industry Forum
"Hydrogen After the Hype: What's Real, What's Changed, and What's Next"
Berlin, Germany and Titusville, Florida, USA (September 1, 2026) – GenH2, a leader in hydrogen infrastructure solutions and a subsidiary of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, announces that Josh McMorrow, CEO of Path2 Hydrogen and Executive Chairman at GenH2, will speak at the Hydrogen State of Industry Virtual Forum. The event, hosted by Darcy Partners, takes place today, September 1, 2026 from 11:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. EST on Zoom.

McMorrow will join the "Hydrogen After the Hype: What's Real, What's Changed, and What's Next" panel, featuring experts representing key steps in the value chain, including production, midstream infrastructure, and offtake. McMorrow will share his perspective on how the hydrogen economy is evolving and where the industry needs to go to actually compete with fossil fuels.

"Hydrogen companies that can produce a low-cost, low-carbon hydrogen molecule, which can then be liquefied, stored and transferred without losses, will prevail," said McMorrow. "I'm looking forward to sharing what we're seeing across the full hydrogen value chain and how hydrogen can compete with, and win against, fossil fuel alternatives."

GenH2's Controlled Storage technology was developed from NASA proof-of-concept research and can eliminate hydrogen losses during liquid hydrogen storage and transfer. Its cryo-refrigerated storage system keeps liquid hydrogen in a sub-cooled state, eliminating venting and preventing boil-off. Without GenH2's breakthrough Controlled Storage, users today are experiencing losses of 30% - 50% of the liquid hydrogen delivered. Such losses prevent hydrogen from effectively competing on cost. Eliminating these losses unlocks the economics of liquid hydrogen.
Josh McMorrow serves as the CEO of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, a German company listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, and as Executive Chairman of GenH2. Josh is a seasoned executive of public and private global companies in industries including hydrogen, industrial gases, energy storage, specialty chemicals and energy production. Josh has led teams on six continents and brings a unique mix of business and legal acumen to bear. With Path2 Hydrogen's acquisition of GenH2 in 2025, the companies are focused on creating a leading pure-play hydrogen public company with essential technology to liquefy, transfer, store, and dispense liquid hydrogen. Josh has a Bachelor of Science in International Business from Trinity University and holds a J.D., with honors, from The University of Texas School of Law.

Darcy Partners provides research and advisory services for organizations seeking to work with emerging technology providers in the energy industry, including oil and gas operators, power and utilities companies and investors. Darcy's platform and services allow energy producers, utilities and capital providers to more rapidly scout, vet, pilot, deploy and invest in innovators across the energy value chain. Darcy's member-driven approach allows members to benefit from not just the knowledge and insights generated by a team of researchers and analysts, but from the experiences of their peers in industry. Learn more at https://darcypartners.com.
GenH2 Corp. is a subsidiary of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, a German company listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. GenH2 is a technology leader in liquid hydrogen infrastructure systems, including Zero-Loss Controlled Storage and advanced hydrogen liquefaction. The company focuses on the production of standardized equipment to speed midstream infrastructure buildout for hard-to-decarbonize sectors. The technology team includes former NASA Hall-of-Fame scientists with decades of experience researching, engineering, and building hydrogen solutions. Learn more about GenH2 at https://genh2.com/.
